title: 第24章 护送任务第25章 蓝衣楼
content_zh:
随着锤炼之力的消失……
轰！
巨响震天，环绕天宇！
伴随着巨声响起之际，耀眼的金色光芒四射，闪耀天际，直上云霄。
“什么情况，不会有什么意外的吧？”
“小妖孽，这小妖孽是不是想把人吓死，搞这么大的动静。”
炼气台外的人不明所以，已经是哗声四起。
炼气台上，九级炼气台融合成了一级，四道身影同时出现在了同一个层面，相互可见。
金光大盛而起，金色的圣光倾洒在炼气台上，沐浴在四人身上，一条巨大的金色光柱源源不绝的灌注进入了肖恩的体内，体泛金光，如同一尊金人。
而乔雅三人同样盘坐下来，迫不及待的接受金光灌体。
因为他们都明白，他们正在接受炼气台第一次出现的金光洗礼！
柔和的金光，如同母亲温暖的手掌抚摸着自己的身体。
在那洗礼金光掠过身体之下，肖恩能够感受得到，自己的丹田，正在朝一种没有丝毫杂色的清澈透明状态进化。
修炼之人，所输出的力量都会有着自身的属性，或者功法特性产生不同的颜色。
而经过了这种金光洗礼，肖恩体内的元气，将会呈现没有任何颜色的透明状。
也就是说，就算是日后肖恩贯通经脉，所输出的元气都是没有丝毫颜色的，也没有人能够从肖恩的元气判断出他的属性力量。
这对于肖恩，同样重要。
毕竟，他是身怀五行本源之人，光是这一点，便能引来腥风血雨的贪婪和扼杀。
所以，这种掩盖，也能够给肖恩提供一个相对稳定的成长空间。
一天的时间很快过去，金光消失不见，四道少年身影被传送了出来。

肖恩虽然晋升到了聚元境三重，但由于经脉闭塞的缘故，从外表看不出有多大的变化。
乔雅三人就不同了，有着一种脱胎换骨的感觉，气息沉稳以及厚重，显然不是进入炼气台之前能够相提并论的。
天狼武馆的两名少年第一时间走到了肖恩的面前，深深的躬了个身，口中真诚道：“娄霍，娄山感谢小兄弟的大恩。”
娄天野大步走了过来，大声的喊道：“小兄弟，霍儿，山儿得以栽培，娄某永感大恩。”
肖恩忙道：“娄馆主太客气了，这是他们的机缘。”
娄天野笑着道：“什么娄馆主，不嫌弃的话，就叫一声娄老哥。”
说完，转身向着四周大声道：“从现在起，百草堂的事就是我天狼武馆的事，凡欺男霸女，滥杀无辜者，杀无赦。”
肖恩的言行，赢得了曾经的对手尊敬，展现给人的不仅仅是惊人的天赋，还有人格品性，将天狼武馆带上了一条修炼的正路。
而且，天狼武馆并没有肖恩嘴里说的那么不堪，上百名炼元境的强者，放在天元大陆任何一个地方，都是一个不容小觑的势力。
百草堂的客厅，福伯有点伤感，惆怅的道：“孩子，是不是要离开了？”
“怎么，小弟要离开了？不行，我不准。”乔雅声音清脆，精致的俏脸上写满了浓浓的不舍。
乔泰同样的不舍，但他知道，这块浅滩之地，留不住肖恩这条真龙，沉默一会后，才缓缓道：“傻丫头，你小弟有更重要的事要办，我们怎么可以耽误他呢？”
肖恩含笑道：“是的，福伯，我打算明天就离开，正想要问你们，知不知道南洲商会在哪里呢？”
“南洲商会？！”
福伯和乔泰一听，眼中现起了精光，他们百草堂就是南洲商会的一个分堂。
只是现在南洲商会处在风雨飘摇之际，他们实在是不想肖恩卷入其中，所以没有言明。
“南洲商会在南武城，距离这里差不多有着数万里之遥，中间隔着五个大城市，如果你要去的话，明天正好有一支商队会从这里去昌平城。”
乔泰犹豫了一下，方才轻声道：“到了昌平城，只要再走一个城市就是南武城了，商队招募护卫，佣金虽然不多，但至少可以结伴走，不会有什么危险。”
肖恩一听大喜，什么佣金不佣金的不重要，和商队一起走总比自己一个人强多了。
content_en:
As the power of tempering disappears...
Boom!
The loud noise shook the sky and surrounded the sky!
As the loud sound rang out, dazzling golden light shone in all directions, shining into the sky and reaching into the sky.
"What's the situation? There won't be any surprises, right?"
"Little monster, does this little monster want to scare people to death and make such a big noise?"
People outside the Qi Refining Platform didn't know why, and there was already a lot of uproar.
On the Qi Refining Platform, the nine-level Qi Refining Platform merged into the first level, and four figures appeared on the same level at the same time, visible to each other.
The golden light rose up, and the golden holy light poured on the Qi Refining Platform, bathing the four people. A huge golden light stream poured into Sean's body, and his body was filled with golden light, like a golden man.
Qiao Ya and the other three also sat down cross-legged and eagerly accepted the golden light.
Because they all understand that they are being baptized by the golden light that appears for the first time on the Qi Refining Platform!
The soft golden light was like a mother's warm palm caressing her body.
Under the baptismal golden light passing over his body, Sean could feel that his Dantian was evolving towards a clear and transparent state without any variegation.
The power output by a cultivator will have its own attributes, or the characteristics of the technique will produce different colors.
After being baptized by this golden light, the vitality in Sean's body will appear transparent without any color.
In other words, even if Sean penetrates the meridians in the future, the vitality output will be colorless, and no one can judge Sean's attribute power from his vitality.
This is equally important to Sean.
After all, he is a person with the origin of the Five Elements. This alone can lead to bloody greed and strangulation.
Therefore, this kind of cover-up can also provide Sean with a relatively stable space for growth.
The day passed quickly, the golden light disappeared, and four young figures were teleported out.
Although Sean was promoted to the third level of Juyuan Realm, due to the blocked meridians, he could not see much change from his appearance.
The three of Qiao Ya were different. They had a feeling of being completely transformed. Their auras were calm and thick, which was obviously not comparable to what they had before entering the Qi Refining Platform.
The two teenagers from the Tianlang Martial Arts School immediately walked up to Sean, bowed deeply, and said sincerely: "Lou Huo, Lou Shan thanks little brother for your great kindness."
Lou Tianye strode over and shouted loudly: "Little brother, Huo'er, Shan'er can be cultivated, Lou will always be grateful."
Sean hurriedly said: "Mr. Lou is too polite, this is their opportunity."
Lou Tianye smiled and said: "Master Lou, if you don't mind, just call me Brother Lou."
After saying that, he turned around and said loudly: "From now on, the affairs of Baicao Hall are the affairs of my Tianlang Martial Arts School. Anyone who bullies men and dominates women and kills innocent people indiscriminately will be killed without mercy."
Sean's words and deeds won the respect of his former opponents. He showed not only his amazing talent, but also his character and character, which set the Tianlang Martial Arts School on the right path of cultivation.
Moreover, the Tianlang Martial Arts Hall is not as bad as what Sean said. Hundreds of strong men in the Refining Realm are a force that cannot be underestimated anywhere in the Tianyuan Continent.
In the living room of Baicao Hall, Uncle Fu felt a little sad and said melancholy: "My child, are you leaving?"
"What, my little brother is leaving? No, I won't allow it." Qiao Ya's voice was clear, and her delicate face was filled with deep reluctance.
Qiao Tai was equally reluctant to give up, but he knew that this shallow land could not keep Sean, a real dragon. After a moment of silence, he slowly said: "Silly girl, your little brother has more important things to do, how can we delay him?"
Sean smiled and said: "Yes, Uncle Fu, I plan to leave tomorrow, and I was just going to ask you if you know where the Nanzhou Chamber of Commerce is?"
"Nanzhou Chamber of Commerce?!"
When Fu Bo and Qiao Tai heard this,There was a light in his eyes. Their Baicao Hall was a branch of the Nanzhou Chamber of Commerce.
It's just that the Nanzhou Chamber of Commerce is in a precarious situation now, and they really don't want Sean to be involved, so they don't say anything.
"The Nanzhou Chamber of Commerce is in Nanwu City, which is tens of thousands of miles away from here. There are five big cities in between. If you want to go, there will be a caravan going to Changping City from here tomorrow."
Qiao Tai hesitated for a moment and then said softly: "When we get to Changping City, the only other city we have to go to is Nanwu City. The caravan recruits guards. Although the commission is not much, at least we can go together and there will be no danger."
When Sean heard this, he was overjoyed. It didn't matter whether it was a commission or not. Going with the caravan was much better than going alone.
